name: Beyondsoft Corporation
summary: Beyondsoft Corporation, together with its subsidiaries, provides consulting, industry solutions, and digital technology services in China and internationally. The company offers data and AI services; cloud services, such as change management, cloud migration, cloud engineering, and modern workplace with centralized infrastructure; business process management services, including workflow management, skilled operations support, and connected customer experience systems; and robotics and digital engineering solutions, and salesforce services.
